title: Issue #4710: a finished-but-unjoined fiber's result is a GC root - the fiber:join registry value survives both evaluator reclaims, so the returned hash is neither emptied nor aliased to a sibling fiber's table.
ok: OK: Issue #4710 fiber:join results are GC roots - the tree-walker and file-mode reclaims mark the fiber-result registry, so a returned hash keeps its own table until the join fetches it
